_comment: Cross-language physics conformance vectors. Read by BOTH backend/tests/test_hassault_physics.py and packages/core/src/modules/hassault/__tests__/conformance.test.ts. These pin that the two implementations agree, not that either is correct in the abstract - correctness is what each side's own unit tests are for. Regenerate only when a rule genuinely changes, and make both suites pass before committing.
